text: Cultivate good morals and cultivation, abide by laws and regulations, have social and environmental awareness, master basic knowledge of mathematics and natural science, basic theories, basic knowledge, basic skills and basic methods related to computing systems, have scientific thinking ability including computational thinking, and the ability to design computational solutions and realize systems based on computational principles. Able to express clearly, play an effective role in a team, have good overall quality, can expand their ability through continuing education or other lifelong learning channels, understand and keep up with the development of the discipline, and have high quality professional and technical personnel in the research, development, deployment and application of computing systems and other related fields with employment competitiveness.
